accountDetails.title: Waihangahia tō pūkete
accountDetails.heading: Waihangahia tō pūkete
accountDetails.intro: E hiahiatia ana tēnei. Haere tonu ki te waihanga i tō pūkete ki {{ server_name }}. Kāore e taea te whakarereke i tēnei ā muri ake.
accountDetails.checking: E tirohia ana mēnā e wātea ana te ingoa kaiwhakamahi …
accountDetails.errorRequired: E hiahiatia ana tēnei. Tēnā homai he ingoa kaiwhakamahi
accountDetails.errorTooLong: He roa rawa, tēnā kōwhiria tētahi mea poto ake
accountDetails.errorInvalidCharacters: He ingoa kaiwhakamahi hē, tēnā whakamahia anake {{ allowed_characters }}
accountDetails.errorNotAvailable: Kāore a {{ username }} i te wātea, tēnā kōwhiria tētahi atu.
redirectConfirm.title: Haere tonu ki tō pūkete
redirectConfirm.heading: Haere tonu ki tō pūkete
redirectConfirm.trust: Mā te haere tonu ka tukuna he urunga ki tō pūkete ki {{ display_url }}.
ssoError.title: I rahua te whakamotuhēhēnga
ssoError.unauthorised: Kāore koe e whakaaetia kia takiuru ki konei.
ssoError.heading: He hapa i puta
ssoError.emailLinkHint: Mēnā kei te kite koe i tēnei whārangi i muri i te pāwhiri i tētahi hononga i tukuna atu ki a koe mā te īmēra, kia mōhio koe kia kotahi anake te pāwhiri i te hononga whakamana, ā, kia whakatuwheratia e koe te hononga whakamana i roto i te kiritaki kotahi e takiuru ana koe.
ssoError.retryHint: Whakamātauria te takiuru anō ki Pangea Chat, ā, mēnā ka mau tonu te raru, tēnā whakapā atu ki te kaiwhakahaere o te tūmau.
authSuccess.title: Kua angitu!
authSuccess.mayClose: Ka taea e koe te kati i tēnei matapihi, ka hoki ki te tono
registrationSuccess.title: Kua angitu te whakamana
registrationSuccess.body: Kia ora! Kua whakamana tō īmēra. Tēnā hoki ki te taupānga ki te takiuru!
passwordResetConfirm.title: Whakamana tautuhi kupuhipa
passwordResetConfirm.intro: Kua tono koe ki te tautuhi anō i tō kupuhipa pūkete Pangea Chat. Pāwhiritia te hononga i raro nei ki te whakamana i tēnei mahi.
passwordResetConfirm.disclaimer: Mēnā kāore koe i te hiahia ki te mahi i tēnei, tēnā katia tēnei whārangi, ā, e kore tō kupuhipa e rerekē.
passwordResetConfirm.submit: Whakamana te whakarerekē i taku kupuhipa
